name: pi-tools
description: Personal timing, context telemetry, handoff, and subagent extensions for Pi.

scripts.format: biome check --vcs-enabled=false --write --linter-enabled=false extensions tests biome.json knip.json package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: biome check --vcs-enabled=false --linter-enabled=false extensions tests biome.json knip.json package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: biome lint --vcs-enabled=false extensions tests biome.json knip.json package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run deadcode && npm test
